Definition: from G4314 and G1159; to expend additionally:--spend more.
BiblicalUsage: Prosdapanao means to spend more, to spend beyond what was agreed. The good Samaritan gives the innkeeper two pence and says, whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Samaritan's promise is what mercy looks like when it is finished: not a gift tossed and forgotten, but a debt taken on until the wounded man is whole.
